question: Do frozen candidate-point errors account for the I65 load-ranking failures, or does a sampled-contact geometry replacement leave substantial load-model disagreement?
scope: Offline analysis of saved I58 native Gazebo/DART Mars figure-eight logs only. Private model kinematics are allowed; zero physics steps or new contact queries. No live controller, observer, feedforward, candidate bank, score, calibration, limit or camera change. No new estimator/adoption or new trajectory runs.

Exact simulated q allowed. All episodes previously inspected; retrospective diagnosis only.
pose_inputs: Recorded exact q and the same mirrored model/patch metadata as I61/I64. Cache force-independent centre c, linear-at-centre Lk and world angular Ak for last3joint rows, all4families. Run mj_kinematics,mj_comPos,mj_jac only; forbid mj_step/step1/step2/forward/collision/contactForce. Verify original F/Nalt maps against I64 and angular/base maps against I61. Portable analysis uses cached maps, not local original model assets.
truth_boundary: Truth is evaluation-only throughout this diagnostic, including reference-point choice, share proxy and counterfactual branch selection. No true contact enters inference or commands. Per-family saved truth points are normal-load-weighted centroids from last reported1ms step, including all positive normal loads; counts only include individual contacts>.05N. Means can lie inside the sphere or outside a material band; retain raw finite means, report geometry flags, never project onto a material surface or discard merely for being interior.
time_limit: Observer interval_mean is previous5ms generalized-load average; geometry/state and truth records are interval-end samples. Exact contact/force history within those5ms is not logged. Neither sampled means nor normal shares are exact interval truth. The raw moment3:6 is already world-frame under observer midpoint convention; do not rotate it again. This audit cannot identify CPU computation delay or uniquely separate timing, friction/routing and dynamics error.
missing_truth: No per-family/per-contact vector forces, separate contact couples or true generalized joint loads were saved. FLOAT32 rollout net contact force/moment are last-sample aggregates, not interval averages. Do not reconstruct unknown tangential force routing, interpolate an invented interval truth, or call the sampled reference a guaranteed geometry ceiling.

Assumes each force vector shares the same total-force direction and its instantaneous normal-load fraction. Positive share with missing point =>unknown; zero-share missing point harmless; never renormalize away an unknown contributor. This is NOT true5ms force allocation or a validated multicontact estimator.

primary_comparison.remaining_disagreement: Always report absolute remaining Nm residual and unchanged component-pass count. Improvement without resolving incompatibility is not a complete geometric explanation. All four routes reported side-by-side; no selecting a favorable control after results.

For nonzero||eC|| report||deltaGeo||/||eC|| as a descriptive sensitivity ratio, not causal fraction. Freecouple=Mraw-cross(pT-c,Fraw); eT-eW=Ak freecouple. No arbitrary post-result subgroup fitting.

No refit. Report corrected/worsened/tied/unknown preferences with full denominators. Do not score same-family duplicate alternatives after artificially changing just one. This is truth-assisted explanatory counterfactual, not a deployable classifier or optimism guarantee.
